name: askfiles
description: Search and browse your own documents with a local model.

scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:upstream
scripts.dev: npm run build:main && node scripts/lib/patches.mjs apply . && node scripts/lib/prisma-client.mjs ensure upstream/server && ASKFILES_DEV=1 electron .
scripts.dev:test: npm run build:main:test && node scripts/lib/patches.mjs apply . && node scripts/lib/prisma-client.mjs ensure upstream/server && ASKFILES_DEV=1 electron .
scripts.lint: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test-build.json --noEmit && tsc -p scripts/eval/tsconfig.json && eslint . && prettier --check .
scripts.package:mac: npm run build:main && PACKAGE_TARGET=mac-arm64 bash scripts/build.sh && npm run notices -- --strict && vitest run scripts/third-party-notices.test.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac dir --arm64 --publish never && bash scripts/sign-adhoc.sh && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac dmg --arm64 --prepackaged release/mac-arm64/AskFiles.app --publish never
scripts.package:win: npm run build:main && PACKAGE_TARGET=win-x64 bash scripts/build.sh && npm run notices -- --strict && vitest run scripts/third-party-notices.test.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac:test: node scripts/build-main.mjs --flavour test && bash scripts/package-test-build.sh mac
scripts.package:win:test: node scripts/build-main.mjs --flavour test && bash scripts/package-test-build.sh win
